Priya Patel: Quick ask — can we pick a 45m slot next week for a combined API+SDK+Console design review? Prefers M/W morning. Proposed agenda: 1) API contract changes (10m) 2) SDK ergonomics demo (15m) 3) Console UX flows (15m) 4) Q&A/next steps (5m)
Alex Gomez: Weds AM sounds ok for me. prefer 11:00-11:45 PT. Is this a preread required?
Priya Patel: Yes, please review the short preread I just uploaded: https://company.docs/preread/api-sdk-console — it's 3 slides + proto diff. Also there's a tiny canary we'll demo.
Micah Lee: 11:00 PT works. Can we include someone from infra for routing/fallback questions? @Jo Park do you have bandwidth?
Jo Park: I can join for the first 20. If infra deep-dive needed, suggest tagging @infra-oncall or grab someone from eng-infra.
Priya Patel: Great. Pre-read checklist below — please mark done before the meeting.
DesignBot: Reminder set: draft meeting added to calendar; RSVP poll attached.
Priya Patel: ```
Pre-read checklist:
- skim slides: https://company.docs/preread/api-sdk-console (3 slides)
- review API diff: proto changes + table of deprecated fields
- run the canary locally: `make demo-run && curl http://localhost:8080/health`
- run quick smoke: `./scripts/smoke.sh --fast` (expect ~20s)
- note any API breaking concerns inline on the doc (use comments)
- add one bullet on risk surface (perf / auth / migration) under "Risks"
- add one example to the "examples" section if you have a snippet
```
Alex Gomez: I'll add my perf bullet. Micah — can you confirm any blocking tests in CI we should wait on?
Micah Lee: CI smoke on canary branch passed earlier today. pinging @qa to confirm e2e isn't flaky.
Jo Park: Also add a short note on rollout plan (canary -> 10% -> 50%) and fallback policy for older SDK clients.
Priya Patel: Thanks. Quick poll: react with :one: for Tue 11am, :two: for Wed 11am, :three: for Thu 9am. I'll lock after EOD Friday.
Alex Gomez: :two:
Micah Lee: :two:
Jo Park: :two:
DesignBot: RSVP poll closed — Wed 11:00 PT chosen. Calendar invite sent to attendees. Agenda doc pinned to thread.
Priya Patel: Awesome — final ask: if you have code snippets, paste them in the "examples" section of the doc (not PR comments). See you Wed. :sparkles:
